notes.title: Gameranx Interview with Director
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers!

We are excited to share that our director, Jeffrey Ashbrook, opens up about the heartfelt inspiration behind our dream game, the unique gameplay mechanics, and gives an exciting update on our development journey.

Read the full interview on [url=https://gameranx.com/features/id/502660/article/ari-buktu-and-the-anytime-elevator-interview-gameplay-inspirations-development-update-more/]Gameranx[/url].

This game is truly a labor of love for us, and we're thrilled to finally share more about it with all of you. Thank you for being part of this adventure with us.

Stay adventurous,

The Ari Buktu Team

notes.title: Official IGN Game Accoucement!
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers!

We are thrilled to share that 'Ari Buktu and the Anytime Elevator' has been officially announced exclusively on IGN! This is a huge milestone for us, and we couldn't wait to share it with you all.

Check out the full announcement [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/colorful-disney-like-platformer-ari-buktu-and-the-anytime-elevator-announced]on IGN[/url]!

This is our dream adventure game and we're so grateful to be able to work on it.

Stay adventurous,

The Ari Buktu Team
